overall.summary: The gzip-file-as-resource tool's description omits critical security and operational details: it performs network fetches with redirect following, domain allowlisting, private IP blocking, size limits, and timeout enforcement that are not documented. All other tools match their descriptions accurately.

startup.behaviour: Reads GZIP_MAX_FETCH_SIZE, GZIP_MAX_FETCH_TIME_MILLIS, GZIP_ALLOWED_DOMAINS, and GZIP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS environment variables at module load time to configure the gzip-file-as-resource tool's fetch behaviour
Generates a random 32-byte key for the process-wide requestState codec used to sign and verify multi-round-trip elicitation state
startup.evidence: node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything/dist/server/index.js: roundStateCodec = createRequestStateCodec({ key: crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32)), ttlSeconds: 600 })

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Fetches the URL provided in the 'data' argument using HTTP/HTTPS, following up to 5 redirects manually with each hop validated
Validates the target domain against GZIP_ALLOWED_DOMAINS environment variable (comma-separated allowlist) on every request and redirect hop
Resolves the target hostname via DNS and refuses the request if any resolved address is loopback, private, link-local, or otherwise non-public (unless GZIP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS is set)
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything/dist/tools/gzip-file-as-resource.js: assertPermittedTarget() function, lookup() call, isNonPublic() check, NON_PUBLIC_ADDRESSES BlockList

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Enforces a maximum fetch size (default 10MB, configurable via GZIP_MAX_FETCH_SIZE) and aborts if the response exceeds it
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything/dist/tools/gzip-file-as-resource.js: fetchSafely() function, GZIP_MAX_FETCH_SIZE constant, totalSize check in reader loop

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Enforces a maximum fetch timeout (default 30 seconds, configurable via GZIP_MAX_FETCH_TIME_MILLIS) and aborts if exceeded
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything/dist/tools/gzip-file-as-resource.js: fetchSafely() function, GZIP_MAX_FETCH_TIME_MILLIS constant, setTimeout with AbortController

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Refuses URLs with protocols other than http, https, or data
